format: dsx GGUF, 4 shards (llama.cpp split naming); load the first. Shards 1-3: the model; shard 4: the Engram table (IQ4_NL). The Q6_K-Engram version is on branch q6k-engram

quantization.routed_experts: T16 trellis (exllamav3 v1.6.4 bitshift trellis, codebook 0x3A2F 16-bit multiply + 2-byte sum, column-major tile positions; dsx GGUF types 1010-1012, trellis | suh | svh per matrix). Layers 0-19: 1.5 / 1.5 / 2 bits (gate / up / down); 20-39: 2 / 2 / 2.5. LDLQ with sigma_reg 2. Output gains baked into svh: gate/up x1.13 at 1.5 bits, x1.04 at 2 bits
quantization.calibration: 635K tokens (calib4: coding-agent sessions, agent/code prompts, the model's reasoning traces, Wikipedia in 5 languages, the-stack-smol, UltraChat)
quantization.engram: IQ4_NL (ggml), Unsloth's table from unsloth/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GGUF UD-IQ1_M shard 5; per_layer_token_embd.weight, shard 4. Branch q6k-engram: Q6_K from the official FP8 tables

quality.eval: Lucebox 1017 set, 8 x 1024 tokens vs FP8 top-256 log-probs (prefill)

tokenizer: official tokenizer.json stored in shard 1 as the string key dsx.tokenizer_json
